ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT C.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT C JOIN MONDIAL_ENCOMPASSES EN ON EN.CONTINENT = C.NAME JOIN MONDIAL_COUNTRY CO ON EN.COUNTRY = CO.CODE JOIN MONDIAL_ECONOMY EC ON EC.COUNTRY = CO.CODE WHERE EC.GDP > 1000000 ORDER BY C.NAME ASC

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: What are the names and areas of those continents?
interactions.intention: Return the name and area of every continent identified as containing at least one country with a GDP greater than 1,000,000.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT C.NAME, C.AREA FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT C WHERE (C.NAME) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C1.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT C1 JOIN MONDIAL_ENCOMPASSES EN1 ON EN1.CONTINENT = C1.NAME JOIN MONDIAL_COUNTRY CO1 ON EN1.COUNTRY = CO1.CODE JOIN MONDIAL_ECONOMY EC1 ON EC1.COUNTRY = CO1.CODE WHERE EC1.GDP > 1000000) ORDER BY C.NAME ASC

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT C.NAME, C.AREA FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT C WHERE (C.NAME) IN (SELECT C2.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT C2 WHERE (C2.NAME) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C1.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT C1 JOIN MONDIAL_ENCOMPASSES EN1 ON EN1.CONTINENT = C1.NAME JOIN MONDIAL_COUNTRY CO1 ON EN1.COUNTRY = CO1.CODE JOIN MONDIAL_ECONOMY EC1 ON EC1.COUNTRY = CO1.CODE WHERE EC1.GDP > 1000000)) AND C.AREA > 10000000 ORDER BY C.AREA DESC, C.NAME ASC
